en.name: Chilli crisp
aliases: lao gan ma style chilli oil
en.summary: Chilli crisp is chilli oil carrying fried solids — flakes, soybeans, onion, garlic, sesame. A commercial jar is shelf-stable: about 12–24 months unopened, and about 1–3 months once opened, because the solids have been fried dry. A homemade batch still holding soft, moist aromatics is a different and more perishable thing: about 4 days refrigerated, or about 3 months frozen.
en.pantry: Unopened commercial jars keep to the printed date in a cool dark cupboard, about 12–24 months — that range is the manufacturer's, not an agency's, and it stops applying the moment the jar is opened. The reason a commercial jar is shelf-stable is that its solids have been fried until dry, so there is no moist low-acid produce left in the oil. After opening, about 1–3 months is the practical pantry limit, the same figure given for opened salad oils, because the failure here is the oil and the fried bits going rancid and stale rather than anything growing. Keep the solids under the oil.
en.fridge: The fridge is for homemade chilli crisp that still contains soft, moist garlic, shallot or ginger. That has not been dried by the frying, so it is fresh low-acid produce sitting under oil — the same situation as garlic in oil, and the same rule applies: refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or lower and use within no more than 4 days, or freeze it. Commercial jars can also be refrigerated after opening if you like; it slows the oil going rancid, at the cost of the oil clouding and solidifying until the jar warms up.
en.freezer: Freezing is the honest way to keep a homemade batch beyond a few days: garlic in oil may be frozen for up to several months, and about 3 months is a sensible limit here. Freeze it in a small jar with headspace or in an ice-cube tray at −18 °C (0 °F), then bag the cubes. Freezing dulls the crunch, which is a real loss, but it is a better trade than leaving fresh aromatics under oil at room temperature.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen chilli crisp in the fridge and use it within a few days, or spoon a frozen cube straight into a hot dish. Never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A rancid, crayon-like or paint-like smell from the oil
Mould on the surface or on solids left standing above the oil
A fizzing, bubbling or bulging jar
Solids gone soft and soggy, with no crunch left at all
tips: Use a dry spoon and keep the solids pressed under the oil.
Make homemade chilli crisp in small batches you will finish in days.
Fry aromatics until genuinely dry and crisp if you want the batch to keep longer.
Botulinum toxin cannot be seen, smelled or tasted, so never judge a fresh-aromatic oil by how it looks — refrigerate or freeze it.

faq.q: Does chilli crisp need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: A commercial jar does not: about 1–3 months in the cupboard after opening. A homemade one containing fresh garlic, shallot or ginger must be refrigerated and used within no more than 4 days.

faq.q: How long does homemade chilli crisp last?
faq.a: About 4 days in the fridge at 4 °C or lower, or about 3 months frozen. Fresh aromatics under oil are the reason it is so short.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar of chilli crisp keep?
faq.a: About 12–24 months in a cool dark cupboard, following the date printed on the jar. That date stops applying once you open it.

faq.q: Why is homemade chilli crisp riskier than shop-bought?
faq.a: Commercial solids are fried dry. Homemade batches often keep soft garlic or ginger in the oil, which is low-acid produce in an oxygen-free environment — the classic setting for botulism.

zh.name: 辣椒脆醬
zh.summary: 辣椒脆醬是含有油炸配料的辣椒油——辣椒片、黃豆、油蔥、蒜酥、芝麻。市售罐裝是常溫商品：未開封大約 12～24 個月，開封後大約 1～3 個月，因為裡面的配料都已經炸到乾透。自製、還留著濕軟辛香料的那種則完全不同，也更容易出問題：冷藏大約 4 天，冷凍大約 3 個月。
zh.pantry: 未開封的市售罐裝放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，大約 12～24 個月——這個範圍來自製造商而不是主管機關，而且一開罐就不再適用。市售罐裝能常溫存放的原因是配料已經炸乾，油裡沒有殘留濕潤的低酸性食材。開封後大約 1～3 個月是實際上限，這個數字和開封後的沙拉油相同，因為這裡壞掉的方式是油和炸料走油耗、變陳，而不是長東西。請讓配料保持在油面以下。
zh.fridge: 冰箱是給「還含有濕軟蒜末、油蔥或薑」的自製辣椒脆醬用的。這些材料沒有被炸乾，等於是新鮮的低酸性食材浸在油裡——和蒜頭泡油是同一種狀況，規則也一樣：放 4 °C 以下冷藏，最多 4 天內用完，否則就冷凍。市售罐裝開封後想冷藏也可以，能減緩油耗，代價是油會變濁、凝固，要回溫才好用。
zh.freezer: 冷凍是讓自製辣椒脆醬撐過幾天的誠實做法：蒜頭泡油可以冷凍數個月，這裡以大約 3 個月為合理上限。裝小罐留膨脹空間，或用製冰盒凍成小塊後裝袋，放 −18 °C。冷凍會讓脆度變鈍，這是真實的損失，但比起把新鮮辛香料泡在油裡放室溫，這個交換划算得多。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的辣椒脆醬請放冷藏解凍，並在幾天內用完，或直接挖一塊丟進熱菜裡。絕對不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 油聞起來有油耗味、蠟筆味或油漆味
醬面或露出油面的配料長霉
配料完全軟掉、沒有任何脆度
tips: 用乾燥的湯匙，並把配料壓在油面以下。
自製時做小份量，幾天內吃得完最好。
想放久一點，辛香料就要炸到真正乾脆。
肉毒桿菌毒素看不到、聞不到、也嚐不出來，所以含新鮮辛香料的油絕對不能靠外觀判斷——請冷藏或冷凍。

faq.a: 市售罐裝不用：開封後放櫥櫃大約 1～3 個月。自製、含新鮮蒜薑或油蔥的一定要冷藏，而且最多 4 天內用完。

faq.q: 自製辣椒脆醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 4 天，或冷凍大約 3 個月。新鮮辛香料泡在油裡，正是它這麼短的原因。

faq.q: 未開封的辣椒脆醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 12～24 個月，以罐上標示日期為準。一開罐那個日期就不再適用。

faq.q: 為什麼自製的比市售的風險高？
faq.a: 市售的配料是炸乾的。自製常常把濕軟的蒜或薑留在油裡，那是低酸性食材處在無氧環境中，正是肉毒桿菌最典型的條件。
